_meta.description: Empirically-fitted MC input distributions for pymodel.py monte_carlo(). Loaded at runtime; missing file falls back to hardcoded judgment values with stderr warning.
_meta.correlation_matrix_note: 6x6 Gaussian copula (judgment): rg/eg +0.3, rg/vac -0.5, ins/cap +0.3, rg/turnover -0.3, all others 0. Adjust here to re-run sensitivity.

rent_growth.description: BLS CPI Rent of primary residence, South region (via FRED). Annual YoY growth from monthly index, last 25 years.
rent_growth.note: South CPI rent includes 2021-2023 surge (8-9%). P50 3.2% exceeds old 2% assumption; P90 4.7% vs old 3%. Both shifted up materially.

expense_growth.description: BLS CPI All Items, South region (via FRED). Annual YoY growth from monthly index, last 25 years. LA insurance shocks ride on top as separate insurance_mult factor.
expense_growth.note: P50 2.1% close to old 2.5% assumption. P10 near zero (post-GFC deflation). P90 4.1% slightly above old 4%. LA insurance shock is modeled separately via insurance_mult.

vacancy.description: Census Housing Vacancy Survey rental vacancy rate, South region (via FRED). Quarterly levels 2001-present, expressed as decimal. NOTE: vacancy in MC is now computed via integer-unit Bernoulli process; this entry is retained for copula marginal calibration reference only.
vacancy.note: South rental vacancy historically higher than the 7% Stoa benchmark. P50 8.2% vs old 7%. Tertiary market deals should consider adding 1-2pts above regional baseline. MC now uses integer-unit Bernoulli vacancy (FIX 1); this entry is reference-only.

insurance_mult.description: Multiplier applied to base insurance input. No clean public series for LA homeowner/multifamily insurance. Widened significantly from national norm to reflect LA crisis regime.
insurance_mult.note: judgment - LA crisis regime; replace with LDI filing data later. Triangular(0.85, 1.0, 1.8). P90 uses ~1.6 from triangular CDF.

exit_cap_spread.description: Spread added to going-in cap rate at exit. No cap rate transaction series available for LA tertiary markets (non-disclosure state).
exit_cap_spread.note: judgment - calibration log has no cap data (LA non-disclosure). Triangular(-25bps, +50bps, +200bps). Upper tail widened from +150bps to +200bps per observed 6.5-16.5% cap dispersion in local 2026 trades. P90 ~200bps from triangular CDF.

empirical_reference.note: No cap rate transaction records found in portfolio/ or deal-intake/ files. LA is a non-disclosure state; CoStar data not ingested. The 6.5-16.5% cap dispersion reference is judgment based on observed range from available deal intake (baker-trails going-in 6.5%, MHP assets typically 10-16%) rather than a fitted series. Update when transactions accumulate.

turnover_rate.description: Annual unit turnover rate for Class B/C small multifamily (4-30 units). Used in integer-unit vacancy model (FIX 1). Correlated with rent_growth via copula (rho = -0.3): high turnover when rents fall.
turnover_rate.note: small Class B/C annual turnover; replace when own T-12s accumulate. Days-vacant per turnover drawn from triangular(20, 45, 120).

capex_vintage.description: Component-life based capex priors for MC vintage capex model (FIX 2). Base capex by age band plus stochastic roof and HVAC replacement events. Applied in MC only; deterministic run() keeps flat capex_unit reserve.
capex_vintage.note: component-life priors; replace with quote/inspection data per deal. Roof events: n_buildings = max(1, round(units/4)); annual_prob = max(0, (age-15)/40). HVAC per unit: annual_prob = max(0, (age-10)/30). Total capped at $3,000/unit.
